title: Daniel in the Lions' Den
summary: Daniel kept praying to God even when a law said he could be punished. God protected Daniel in the lions' den and showed that He is faithful.

read_it.prompt: Read how Daniel kept praying, faced danger, and saw God protect him.

tell_it: Daniel loved God and prayed every day. Some leaders made a trick law to get Daniel in trouble. Daniel kept praying to God, was thrown into a lions' den, and God shut the lions' mouths.
understand_it: This passage teaches that prayer matters and God is faithful. Daniel did not know exactly what would happen, but he kept honoring God when it was costly.
age_5_7_explanation: Daniel prayed to God, even when he was told not to. God was with Daniel near the lions.
age_8_11_explanation: Daniel had a habit of prayer before trouble came. He kept honoring God, and God protected him in a scary place.
teen_explanation: Daniel's courage came from steady faithfulness, not a sudden dramatic moment. His public obedience grew out of private prayer and trust in God.
key_truths: Prayer matters even when life is hard.
God is faithful when His people face pressure.
Obeying God may cost us something, but God is worth trusting.
life_application: If friends pressure you to hide what is right, Daniel reminds you to keep doing the right thing with humility. You can pray, ask for wisdom, and stay faithful.

quiz_questions.question: What did Daniel keep doing even after the new law?
quiz_questions.explanation: Daniel continued his regular habit of praying to God.

quiz_questions.question: God protected Daniel in the lions' den.
quiz_questions.explanation: God sent His angel and shut the lions' mouths.

memory_verse.prompt: Remember that God was able to protect Daniel in the lions' den.

discussion_questions: What habits can help you trust God before trouble comes?
When might it be hard to do the right thing at school or with friends?

activity.title: Prayer Window
activity.instructions: Draw a window like Daniel's prayer window. Inside it, write three things you can pray about this week.

prayer_prompt: Lord, teach me to pray and trust You. Help me stay faithful when I feel pressure.
